map.权利人向义务人提出履行请求、义务人同意履行义务、权利人提起诉讼或申请仲裁，以及与: A claim for performance made by the right holder to the obligor, the obligor agreeing to perform, the right holder filing a suit or applying for arbitration, and any other situation equivalent to a suit all interrupt the limitation period and start it running again.
map.涉及最长保护期（20 年）的，自权利受损害之日起超过 20 年法院不予保护。: For the longest term (20 years), a court offers no protection once 20 years have passed from the day the right was infringed.
map.诉讼时效届满日计算 使用指南: Statute of limitations expiry calculator usage guide
map.诉讼时效期间内发生催款、起诉、对方承诺还款等中断事由的，时效重新计算 3 年。: When an interrupting event such as a demand for payment, a lawsuit or the other party promising to repay occurs during the limitation period, the period is recalculated as 3 years from that point.
map.诉讼时效期间是法定期间，届满日若为周末或法定假日通常顺延至其后第一个工作日，但具: The limitation period is a statutory period; if the expiry date falls on a weekend or public holiday it is normally postponed to the next working day, though the accepting court's practice governs; file the suit early rather than waiting until the last moment.
map.输入权利受侵害或约定履行期限届满的起算日期，依据《民法典》第188条计算诉讼时效: Enter the starting date when the right was infringed or the agreed performance period expired; the expiry of the limitation period is computed under Article 188 of the Civil Code, and the remaining days are shown live so you can assert the right in time.
map.：约定还款日 2023-01-01，时效自次日起算 3 年，届满日为 2026-: : with the agreed repayment date 2023-01-01, the 3-year limitation runs from the following day and expires on 2026-01-01; if no suit is filed and no interruption occurs before 2026-01-01, the claim may fail on limitation.
map.：若 2024-06-01 通过短信/书面催款并保留证据，时效自该日起重新计算: : if a demand is made by SMS or in writing on 2024-06-01 and evidence is kept, the period is recalculated as 3 years from that date, giving a new expiry of 2027-06-01.
